name: SemaevTower
why_it_matters: Defines the general Semaev summation polynomial S_m over any commutative ring by the resultant recursion S_{m} = Res_T(S_{m-1}(..., T), S3(x_{m-2}, x_{m-1}, T)) with fixed Sylvester sizes (2^(m-3), 2), proves agreement with S3 and with the existing S4, the degree upper bound 2^(m-2) in the last variable, and the forward direction (a chain of S3 witnesses forces S_m = 0) at every level. The repository previously had only the one-step tool resultant_eq_zero_of_common_root and the secp256k1-specific projective frozen family.

default_budget.note: Not a model-loop target: statements frozen before proof; the proofs were prototyped in a design study (Mathlib-only scratch file) before this freeze and are ported in the promoting commit.

hint: semaevSlice_succ_eval by resultant_map_map with evalRingHom; Sm_four by rfl after rewriting; degree bound by a column-weight bound on the Sylvester determinant (weights 2 on the first 2^(s+1) columns, 0 on the last 2); forward chain by induction using resultant_eq_zero_of_common_root with the degree bound.
